core/storage.mjs.content: export function databaseEvidence(db){return {async put(key,value){const bytes=new Uint8Array(value);if(bytes.length>512*1024)throw new Error('Keep evidence files under 512 KB.');let binary='';for(let i=0;i<bytes.length;i+=8192)binary+=String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i,i+8192));await db.prepare('INSERT INTO cb_evidence_payloads VALUES (?,?)').bind(key,btoa(binary)).run()},async get(key){const row=await db.prepare('SELECT payload FROM cb_evidence_payloads WHERE object_key=?').bind(key).first();if(!row)return null;return {body:Uint8Array.from(atob(row.payload),c=>c.charCodeAt(0))}},async delete(key){await db.prepare('DELETE FROM cb_evidence_payloads WHERE object_key=?').bind(key).run()}}}

# Contextual Nigerian photography

These photographs are contextual, not CivicBench projects or endorsements. No AI-generated imagery is included.

## community-volunteers.webp
- Photographer/publisher: Lagos Food Bank Initiative.
- Source: https://www.pexels.com/photo/happy-volunteers-carrying-boxes-8061641/
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria. Taken 15 May 2021, published 25 May 2021.
- License: https://www.pexels.com/license/
- Treatment: resized, converted to WebP; CSS crops for layout.

## library-collaboration.webp
- Title: Wiki Loves Library NIgeria 41.
- Author: James Rhoda, dated 15 December 2022.
- Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Wiki_Loves_Library_NIgeria_41.jpg
- License: CC BY-SA 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
- Treatment: resized and converted to WebP, CSS crop. The adapted photograph retains CC BY-SA 4.0.
- Context: Wiki Loves Libraries participants, Nigeria.
